title: Concept: Oracle error code in a response
description: An Oracle ORA- or PLS- error code in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The code names the failing object, the column and sometimes the package, which tells an attacker the exact schema and where to aim the next query.
applicability: Deployments that render an Oracle ORA- or PLS- error code into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The code names the failing object, the column and sometimes the package, which tells an attacker the exact schema and where to aim the next query.
